name: Collingwood Weekly
tagline: The week around the south Georgian Bay.
description: Collingwood Weekly is the Friday-morning round-up for Collingwood and the south Georgian Bay towns — Wasaga Beach, Clearview and The Blue Mountains. Every week: what the councils and the counties decided, the roads and the forecast for the weekend ahead from Ontario 511 and Environment Canada, local sport, what is on, and one contested local issue with the strongest case on each side. Hosted by Mira, the Nerra Network's AI host — the stories are chosen and written by software from named local sources.
